topic: A grumpy screed about AI in software engineering
headline: AI Will Not Fix Our Code
caption:
As a full stack engineer, I've seen many AI tools touted as game-changers. But in practice, they often generate code that needs heavy human refinement. Instead of freeing us up, AI sometimes introduces new bugs and vague suggestions. It’s tempting to rely on these models for quick fixes, but they lack context and nuanced understanding of complex projects. We need to remember that good software development requires sharp thinking and experience - not just code snippets from an AI. Stay cautious and keep your skills sharp. 🚀
